description: Hyperliquid historical liquidations, trades, candles, paper trading
rules: Connect to https://mcp.ironflow.sh/mcp (54 tools) or https://mcp.ironflow.sh/data (42 read-only data tools) over Streamable HTTP, or run it locally with npx -y @ironflowsh/mcp.
No API key is needed to start: keyless calls get 30 requests per minute, 300 per day and 24 hours of history. A free key from https://ironflow.sh/key gives 60 per minute and 14 days.
Markets take display symbols (BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC) or Hyperliquid names (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA).
Times take Unix ms, Unix seconds, ISO 8601 or relative times such as -7d, -24h and now.
For data the named tools do not cover, call describe_data first, then run_query with one read-only ClickHouse SELECT.
Ironbox is paper trading only: a simulated account with 10,000 USD and live prices.
